'''Oren Ward''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Jedi hunter/Legends|Jedi killer]] who was captured by [[Voontara Fa'athra]] and imprisoned in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] in [[Fa'athra's Palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Ward's friend [[Burnok]] recruited help in rescuing Ward from the palace.

==Behind the scenes==
Oren Ward is a non-player character from the massively multi-player online role playing game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is voiced by [[Kiff VandenHeuvel]].
